name: weavemas
description: WeaveMAS: High-observability multi-agent orchestration with sandboxed status machines, native MCP tooling, and real-time dashboard UI.
suggestedPrompts: Use the weave-authoring skill to create a minimal, single-file (stageless) KidsWiki pipeline that writes short text articles for children aged 3 to 12 (defaulting to age 4). Include two agents: a Writer (responsible for age-appropriate readability) and a Fact Checker (strictly verifying factual accuracy, with an in-place revision loop if any statement is wrong), saving the final verified text article to article.md in output/<topic_slug>_<age>yo/.
Verify subagent status in the current working directory
